stages.title: Level 1 → 45
stages.summary: 754.8M EXP to 45 — and Episode quests pay 97–99% of it. Zone progression pairs Poeta→Verteron (Elyos) and Ishalgen→Altgard (Asmodian).
actions: Follow Episode quests exclusively — side content is optional EXP
Open all Sealed Dungeons you pass (61 per faction, ~15k Kinah + 2 Daevanion Crystals + a title each)
Fill Daevanion skill boards as they unlock (~13 / 20 / 30 / 40) — +4 total skill levels by 45
Stigma slots open at Lv 22 / 27 / 32 / 37 — plan which 4 stigmas you'll level
Levels 30–39 story covers only ~70% of EXP — top up with Sealed Dungeons and dailies

stages.title: Fresh 45 — the ~700–750 GS baseline
stages.summary: Story done. Every per-week loop unlocks. Do NOT invest upgrade materials yet — everything here is replaced within days.
actions: Set up the weekly loop: Duties 5/day, Exploration cubes, Ascension Trial, Arena — see the Weekly Checklist
Start the AP engine: ~1,000 AP per Duty, sieges Mon/Thu/Sat 12:00 UTC for ~45k bursts
Roll substats on cheap gold (Epic) gear — these rolls become your first Transfer donors
Farm 1★ expeditions (Krao Cave / Draupnir) for the ilvl 54 band

stages.title: First keeper tier — ilvl 70
stages.summary: The first gear worth investing in: Aulamus weapons/accessories (Urugugu Canyon) and Vakron armor (Vakron Sky Island).
actions: Hit 1,400 GS via ilvl-54 gear — no enhancement investment needed
Farm Urugugu Conquest for Aulamus weapons + Vakron for armor
Transfer your rolled substats into the keepers (donor consumed, % of max roll preserved)
Enhance keepers to +10 safely — only +10→+15 can fail

stages.title: Mid tier — ilvl 86
stages.summary: Fire Temple (Enraged Kromede weapons) and Ferocious Horn Den (Nuakum armor + Wrathful Ego for Draconic crafting).
actions: Transfer forward from ilvl-70 keepers — full-value rules apply above 70
Push the raid set pieces to +10, then budget for +10→+15 (65/50/35/25/20% with +5% pity)
Start Stigma Lv 20+ plans — Superior Stigma Shards come from the AP shop tiers
Begin Transcendence dungeons at 2,200 GS for the Arcana card engine

stages.title: Endgame — ilvl 102 & Sanctuary
stages.summary: Abyssal Forge: Ludra (2,800) → Corroded Decontamination Facility (3,500) → Chalice of Muspel (4,300/4,500 Hard).
actions: Ludra first: bracelets are the raid-only progression slot
4 attempts per raid per week, consumed on entry — use the checklist to track them
Amplify past +15 (66/50/33/25/20%, shrinking pity) on your BiS pieces only
Potential (4 levels, always succeeds) on Soul Bound PvP pieces with spare AP

link.label: Check raid gates in Gear Check

altGuide: Alts are the weekly-cap multiplier: Ascension Trial 3/wk, Superior stones 5/wk, Conquest cubes, event shops — all per character.
Default ~4 character slots (up to 8 reported); alt efficiency ≈70–80% of a geared main (community estimate).
What syncs across the roster: Founder rewards (cross-character since Oct 6/7), account-wide pets/titles collections.
What does NOT sync: Daeva Pass bills per character (1,500 Quna each for Season 1), Market access requires membership.
Best alt roles: a second Gathering profession set for the manastone/craft economy, and a cash-cow farmer for the ilvl-54 band.
Respect the anti-bot walls: no player-to-player trades — move value through the Marketplace (membership) or Bound sinks.
